'''2007 Endor Regionals Buddy Walters LS Local Uprising (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Buddy Walters]] at [[2007 Endor Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Local Uprising (V) / Liberation (V) (Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth)|OVS4-11-Local_Uprising-remaster.webp|label=Local Uprising (V) / Liberation (V)}}
* '''Deck name:''' Mike makes me good decks to play
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
